title: Mexicali ULI indicator metadata
description: Documentation accompanying one indicator's results. Every indicator delivered to the Mexicali Urban Liveability Index must be accompanied by a metadata document validating against this schema.

id.description: The '#' of the indicator in the ULI workbook

role.description: 'composite' indicators are assembled centrally from their children and are not calculated directly by an analyst

composite_parent.description: Workbook '#' of the parent indicator this one contributes to

adapted_from.description: The source article(s) from the ULI review that this indicator was adapted from. This is provenance, NOT the health evidence.

statement.description: Revised 'reason this matters' text: why this indicator matters for health and wellbeing in Mexicali, in plain language, supported by the evidence below.

health_pathways.description: One or more pathways from uli.vocab.HEALTH_PATHWAYS linking this indicator to health

arid_context.description: How the arid, hot climate of Mexicali modifies the expected relationship (e.g. shade and seasonality conditioning walkability)

evidence.description: At least one citation, independent of the article the indicator was adapted from, demonstrating a meaningful health or wellbeing benefit

claim.description: The specific health/wellbeing claim this reference supports

population.description: Study population and setting; note if not comparable to Mexicali

effect.description: Effect size with uncertainty, e.g. 'RR 0.92 (95% CI 0.88-0.96) per 10% increase'

threshold_support.description: Any threshold or dose the evidence supports, and whether it differs from the one originally proposed

measures.description: The distinct ways this indicator is measured (one per lens, or per lens-and-parameter combination)

measure_family.description: Optional grouping slug shared by measures that are variants of one construct, including across workbook rows (e.g. all air quality measures, or mean temperature and days above a comfort threshold). Lets related rows be delivered and read as a single indicator family.

temporal_basis.description: How the measure summarises over time (see uli.vocab.TEMPORAL_BASES): annual_mean, seasonal_mean, threshold_exceedance_days, and so on. Required whenever a measure_family contains more than one time basis.

description.description: Operational definition: exactly what was computed, in one or two sentences

threshold.description: Threshold distance(s) or cut-point(s) applied, in the unit of the measure

include_in_index.description: Whether this measure is offered as an input to the composite liveability index

index_notes.description: Normalisation, capping or transformation the central index step should be aware of. Do not normalise the values yourself.

redistributable.description: Whether the licence permits sharing derived layers via Reimagina Urbana

condesa_coverage.description: Whether this source covers the Condesa new development area in south-east Mexicali

summary.description: How the measure was computed, in enough detail for someone else to reproduce it

condesa_treatment.description: How coverage of the Condesa new development was achieved or, if it could not be, why not
